scene: Beyond the beads lies a panoramic sky terrace bustling with departing transports.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a wide open-air transit balcony. On the far left sits a coiled maglev dragon train with open doors. At the centre stands the broad-shouldered Pacific Islander man in a floral shirt with top knot and ukulele, beside an open cable pod. On the far right moors a solar-sail junk.
shown: a sleek serpentine maglev train waiting at a neon platform on the far left
a bubble-shaped cable car hovering open beside the central railing
a wooden junk with glowing solar sails moored at the dock on the far right
